instruction: Extract the embedded subtitles from the video and save them as 'subtitles.srt' in the video's directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting subtitles from video.mp4 and saving them as subtitles.srt in /home/user/ directory. Evaluator checks if the SRT file exists, has content (size > 100 bytes), and contains valid SRT format with proper timestamp structure and subtitle text. Progressive scoring: 0.3 for file exists, 0.3 for has content, 0.4 for valid SRT format.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.3 points for file creation, 0.3 points for file having content > 100 bytes, 0.4 points for valid SRT format with proper timestamps and subtitle text

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file existence at expected path '/home/user/subtitles.srt'
Robust SRT format validation: Getter validates proper timestamp format (HH:MM:SS,mmm --> HH:MM:SS,mmm), sequential numbering, subtitle text blocks, and requires at least 1 valid subtitle entry
Progressive scoring appropriately rewards: file existence (0.3), content presence (0.3), and valid SRT format structure (0.4)
Format validation logic correctly parses subtitle blocks and verifies all required components (number, timestamp, text)
While evaluator cannot verify subtitles originated from the specific video file, it can reliably distinguish between properly extracted SRT subtitles vs arbitrary/random file content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding minimum subtitle count threshold (e.g., at least 3-5 subtitle blocks) to better ensure actual extraction vs minimal manual creation
Could add timestamp sequence validation to verify timestamps are in chronological order
Minor enhancement: validate timestamp ranges are reasonable (e.g., not all zeros, duration makes sense for video length)
